step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts Arc Publishing's (The Washington Post) web rendering platform. Public users hit an origin ECS cluster, which routes requests to S3 for static resources or pre-rendered content, or to Lambda for dynamic page rendering. Developers and Newsroom staff configure templates in DynamoDB and deploy code to Lambda. The Lambda function accesses templates in DynamoDB and fetches live content through a second ECS proxy cluster, which caches raw responses in ElastiCache and fetches missing content from external CMS endpoints.
